decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core promise of trusted second-channel communication and likely complements its wider identity platform, so a medium-sized security specialist would usually retain it unless demand proved clearly weak.
A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture is highly consistent with the firm's core cryptography and authentication capabilities and looks strategically central rather than expendable.
The hardware signature token still matches the firm's security portfolio, but hardware-heavy niche products are more exposed to portfolio pruning if software-based signing options scale better.

A payment-network compliance security suite serves regulated, security-sensitive customers well and is likely worth keeping, though its niche scope makes it somewhat more reviewable than the firm's broad platform products.
